$what: What a lane's specification is built from. A lane's pre-writer checkpoint records a digest of these (lib/handlers/spec-inputs-digest.js); on resume, a lane whose story is not completed and whose recorded digest differs from today's is specified again, then stops at pause 2 — its approved spec was made from inputs that no longer hold.
$why: AMSD-2974, 2026-10-04: the gotransit lane resumed a spec approved before the dependency facts existed. The spec told the writer to bump a version its SI now forbids; twelve opus attempts each concluded 'nothing to change'. Nothing recorded what the spec was made from, so nothing could tell it was stale. Operator-approved 2026-10-04.
$templatesWhy: Templates the spec seams render into their prompts without owning them (the estimation assessment's framing for the detective, cpa-inference, spec-agent): a change to one changes the spec as surely as a seam template does.
